goal: Provide an isolated StarCraft II map for repeatable runtime VM, reusable Galaxy library, and controlled tactical-scenario verification without modifying mission or commander packages.
acceptance: The generated RuntimeLab.SC2Map contains no CMRE package dependency or mission script.
The runtime VM registers and responds to system.ping through its Bank transport.
The generic-library self-test produces its existing observable pass evidence.
A deterministic two-player tactical arena is created and exposes readiness through the runtime Bank.
The build uses current runtime VM and CMLib sources without maintaining forked copies.
